title: gh api rate_limit
description: The caller's rate limits, of which kit reads the REST (core) and GraphQL windows in `modules/bash/forge/github.sh` (forge/github:quota, and forge/github:limited when a read was refused) and folds them in `modules/jq/forge.jq` (forge::github_quota, forge::github_spent). The types are rate-limit-overview of GET /rate_limit in GitHub's REST OpenAPI description, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/github/rest-api-description/main/descriptions/api.github.com/api.github.com.json, whose resources always hold core and may lack graphql.

reset.description: When the window resets, in seconds since the epoch
